jobs.description:
Sparrow Quantum is seeking a student assistant with a data science background to support our business functions with automation and data management

• 
Type: Part-time student position

• 
Hours: 10 to 15 hours per week, planned around your studies

• 
Compensation: Hourly wage according to qualifications

• 
Location: Frederiksberg

• 
Start date: February 1 (flexible)

• 
Reports to: VP of Finance

About the role

Do you want to apply your data science skills to real business problems in a deep-tech scale-up?

As Sparrow Quantum grows, so does the data behind the business: customer and supplier records, orders, finance figures, and hiring data spread across spreadsheets and systems. We are looking for a student assistant to bring order to that data and automate the work around it, in close collaboration with finance, operations, HR, sales, and marketing.

To be clear about the scope: this is applied data work for business functions, not machine learning research. Your hours will be split evenly between data management and automation on one side, and business support across the company on the other.

Responsibilities

Data management

• 
Clean and maintain business data across finance, operations, HR, sales, and marketing

• 
Support on developing data flows between our systems, so the same data is not entered twice

• 
Maintain data quality checks, naming conventions and documentation, and keep them up to date

• 
Support maintaining dashboards and reports that give management and teams an up-to-date view of key figures, in tools such as Power BI and Excel

Automation

• 
Support on mapping recurring manual processes and propose which to automate first

• 
Help build and maintain automations in Python or other tools, and with tools such as Microsoft 365

• 
Use AI tools, including large language models, to speed up data handling and reporting, within our rules for confidential information

• 
Document what you build so colleagues can run it when you are not there

Business support (about half your time)

• 
Support finance, operations, and HR with day-to-day tasks such as documentation, purchasing, invoicing, and supplier contact

• 
Take on ad hoc analyses and small projects wherever the business needs a hand

Who we are looking for

You enjoy turning messy data into something people can rely on, and you would rather fix a process than repeat it. You are curious about how a company works across functions, and you can explain your work to colleagues without a technical background.

You have

• 
Enrollment in a bachelor's or master's program in data science or a related field, with at least 1.5 years of study left

• 
Experience with Python for data work, including pandas or similar libraries

• 
Knowledge of SQL and relational data

• 
Experience cleaning, structuring, and visualizing real-world data

• 
Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, and a realistic view of where they fail

• 
A structured, reliable way of working

• 
Discretion with confidential information

• 
Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to have

• 
Experience with Power BI, Power Automate or other Microsoft 365 tools

• 
Experience with APIs or simple data pipelines

• 
Understanding basic accounting and financial data

• 
Curiosity about quantum technology. No physics background required

What we offer

• 
Flexibility: hours planned around lectures and exams, with lighter weeks when your studies require it

• 
Visible impact: the data flows, dashboards and automations you build will be used by the team every day, not filed away

• 
A view of the whole company: insight into how a deep-tech scale-up works across R&D, production, sales and finance

• 
A supportive team: colleagues who share knowledge freely and expect you to ask questions

• 
Shaping your role: it is a new role, and you can help shape it

How to apply

Scroll down to submit your CV and a short cover letter in English. In the letter, describe one data or automation project you have worked on: the problem, what you built and what it changed. A GitHub link or a few sentences is enough.

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is 1st December. For questions about the role, contact Anna Sogli, agd@sparrowquantum.com.

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

jobs.occupation: Tribe Lead for Cards & Financing Platform tribe
jobs.description:
Our customers deserve banking that fits their lives, not the other way around. As Tribe Lead for the Cards & Financing Platform tribe, you will lead an organisation dedicated to enabling intuitive, embedded, and tailored offerings across cards and financing. This is a rare opportunity to lead at scale within a team that puts customers at the center of every decision.

Overview of Danske Bank

Danske Bank is a leading Nordic financial services group dedicated to strengthening its position in the market by delivering innovative, resilient, and sustainable core capabilities. The mission of the Cards & Financing Platform tribe focuses on enhancing customer experiences across all markets with offerings in mortgages, lending, cards, and branch services, including core financing capabilities supporting Realkredit Danmark, in close collaboration with sister tribes responsible for our customer-facing offerings.

We prioritise sustainability and have refined our organisational structure into focused tribes, each led by experts in their respective fields. The Cards & Financing Platform is a vital component, encompassing approximately 280 colleagues across more than 20 squads primarily located in Denmark, India and Lithuania, all committed to advancing our Forward '28 strategy.

What you will be doing

You will co-lead the Cards & Financing Platform tribe together with the Tribe Leadership Team, which includes an IT Lead, Tribe Coach, and Tribe Architect. All Product Owners and leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads) will report to you, making your leadership central to how the tribe collaborates and delivers on the Danske Bank Forward '28 strategy.

More specifically, you will:

• Guide Product Owners and leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads) on roadmap priorities and tribe backlog

• Lead strategy, Annual Business Reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews across the tribe

• Engage senior stakeholders to align on priorities, dependencies, and major decisions

• Engage with large international vendors as part of the tribe's delivery commitments

• Act as HR manager for Product Owners, leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads), Business Manager, and Management Coordinator

• Drive tribe performance across delivery, adoption, business outcomes, efficiency, and cost, working closely with commercial stakeholders to realise the value of existing and new solutions

• Drive the development and implementation of GenAI solutions and embed AI-enabled ways of working across the tribe to improve productivity, quality, and customer and business outcomes.

• Drive the tribe’s risk and compliance agenda and, together with the Tribe Leadership Team, advance platform modernisation while maintaining reliable end-to-end services.

About you

• Solid experience leading large, cross-functional technology or product organisations

• Background in cards, financing or daily banking, with a genuine interest in technology

• Ability to translate strategic direction into clear priorities and communicate them accessibly

• Track record of delivering solutions that improve customer experiences

• Skilled at building agile, collaborative cultures where colleagues feel trusted and supported

• Skilled at engaging with senior leaders and managing complex stakeholder relationships

• Open to continuous personal and professional development

What we offer you

You will join the organisation at an important moment, with real responsibility and genuine trust from the start. The role is hybrid, with three to four days per week in the office in Copenhagen to support collaboration and knowledge sharing across a geographically spread tribe. You will have room to develop your own skills while supporting your colleagues to do the same, within a team that values openness, belonging, and shared learning.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you would like to know more about the position, please reach out to Hiring Manager Mark Wraa-Hansen (mark.wraa.hansen@danskebank.dk) head of Personal Banking DK. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply at your earliest convenience or by 23.11.26 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant – Actuarial Services, Financial Services Advisory
jobs.description:
Are you an actuary with a couple of years of experience looking to broaden your career beyond a traditional actuarial role? Would you like to work across insurance, audit and advisory, helping some of the largest financial institutions solve complex actuarial and business challenges?

Then you might be our new colleague in KPMG’s Financial Services Advisory team in Copenhagen.

The opportunity

We are looking for an ambitious actuary with approximately 2 years of relevant professional experience to strengthen our actuarial capabilities within Financial Services Advisory.

You will join a multidisciplinary team working with insurance companies and other financial institutions. Your assignments will vary from supporting our audit teams on actuarial matters to advising clients directly on actuarial, risk, regulatory and transformation topics.

The role provides a strong opportunity to combine your actuarial expertise with broader business and advisory experience and to develop your career in an environment where you will work closely with experienced colleagues, clients and specialists across KPMG.

What you will be doing

Depending on your experience and interests, your work may include:

• Performing actuarial analyses of insurance liabilities and technical provisions.

• Supporting the audit of insurance companies, including review and challenge of actuarial assumptions, methodologies, models and calculations.

• Working with Solvency II, financial reporting and other regulatory requirements relevant to insurers.

• Reviewing and challenging reserving methodologies, models, assumptions and data.

• Supporting actuarial modelling, validation and quantitative analyses.

• Advising insurance clients on improvements to their actuarial processes, governance, controls and documentation.

• Contributing to projects at the intersection of actuarial science, risk management, regulation, data and technology.

• Working directly with clients and gradually taking responsibility for your own workstreams and deliverables.

• Collaborating with colleagues across KPMG in Denmark and our international network.

The aim is not only for you to apply your actuarial skills, but also to develop into a trusted adviser who understands both the numbers and the business behind them.

Who we are looking for

We expect that you:

• Hold a relevant quantitative degree, ideally within actuarial mathematics, insurance mathematics or a closely related field.

• Have approximately 2 years of relevant experience, for example from an insurance company, consultancy or audit firm.

• Have practical experience with actuarial calculations, models or insurance liabilities.

• Have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy working with complex quantitative topics.

• Are interested in understanding the commercial, regulatory and strategic context surrounding actuarial work.

• Communicate clearly and are comfortable discussing your analyses with both specialists and non-specialists.

• Enjoy working collaboratively and taking responsibility.

• Are fluent in English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage.

Experience within life insurance, non-life insurance, pensions, reserving, Solvency II or actuarial audit would be particularly relevant, but we do not expect you to be an expert in all areas.

What we offer

At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to build a career that extends beyond a traditional actuarial role.

You will become part of Financial Services Advisory, where we bring together expertise across insurance, banking, risk, regulation, data, technology and transformation. You will work alongside experienced specialists while being given responsibility early in your career.

We offer:

• A steep learning curve and exposure to different insurance companies and business models.

• The opportunity to combine actuarial expertise with advisory and business skills.

• Direct interaction with clients and senior colleagues.

• Access to KPMG's Danish and international actuarial and financial-services network.

• Opportunities to work on projects beyond traditional actuarial assignments.

• A collaborative and informal environment with strong focus on professional and personal development.

Most importantly, we offer the opportunity to help shape and grow our actuarial capability in Financial Services Advisory.

Why KPMG?

You’ll thrive in a professional environment that emphasizes close team collaboration and cross-functional, international partnerships. You won’t just be a part of a team; You will become integral to a motivated and skilled team of over 60 international professionals driven by progression and professional development.

Our culture is not just a buzzword – It is social, informal, and open, with a flat organizational structure. We value diversity, social well-being, collaboration, and innovative thinking.

Interested?

If you find yourself aligned with this opportunity, then we are excited to get to know you better. Feel free to contact Senior Manager, Teis Dengsøe, tdengsoee@kpmg.com, or Partner Hans Jørgen Andresen, hansjandresen@kpmg.com. We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG

Do you want to lead a team of six and shape the future of data and analytics in Danica? As Head of Business Data & Analytics, you will develop people, set direction and strengthen the link between data, insights and business value.

Your team works across business and data analytics, partnering with the business and management to turn complex challenges into actionable insights and data-driven solutions. Data is a key enabler of Danica’s strategy: your work will support better decisions, customer experiences, business performance and growth. This role combines people leadership with a strong interest in data and business, helping the team and wider organisation strengthen their use of analytics as our capabilities evolve.

What you will be doing

You will strengthen analytical maturity and continuously develop our data and analytics capabilities. As our new data platform evolves, you will leverage opportunities enabled by the platform, AI and other emerging technologies to improve how we generate insights and turn data into tangible business value.

Your team will be a trusted business analytics partner to stakeholders across Danica, providing insights that enhance business decisions.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Lead and develop a team of six, helping them turn data and analysis into actionable business insights.

• 
Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Danica, acting as a trusted analytics partner while providing credible professional challenge.

• 
Continuously develop the team's analytical capabilities, methods and ways of working, fostering a strong analytical mindset and high professional standards.

Collaborate with the leadership team in Data & Analytics to set direction, align priorities and strengthen how data and analytics create value across Danica.

About you

We imagine that you are an experienced people leader with a strong background in analytics, data or a closely related field. You do not necessarily need to be the deepest technical specialist in the team, but you should have sufficient analytical understanding to challenge, guide and develop the team.

• 
People leadership. You have demonstrated leadership experience and enjoy developing people. You lead with trust, curiosity and a collaborative mindset.

• 
Analytical expertise. You bring strong analytical expertise and act as a trusted sparring partner for the team.

• 
Business understanding. You understand how business questions can be translated into data use cases, analysis and actionable insights.

• 
Direction and delivery. You are able to set direction while balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day delivery.

• 
Stakeholder relationships and communication. You build strong stakeholder relationships and are comfortable constructively challenging established thinking. You communicate complex topics clearly and confidently across technical and non-technical audiences.

What we offer you

• 
Influence and impact. Shape the future of Business Data & Analytics in an area where data increasingly drives business development and decisions. Develop the team’s analytical competencies and influence how new data capabilities create business value across Danica.

• 
Leadership development. Genuine opportunities to develop your own leadership capabilities.

• 
Hybrid working. Hybrid working arrangements, typically three days per week in the office.

Interested**?**

Apply today! If you have any questions about the position, please reach out to the Head of Data & Analytics Thomas Jonsson at thjon@danica.dk or on +45 26857120. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply at your earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Help shape how KMD engages strategic accounts - connecting key societal agendas with customers’ strategic priorities through marketing advisory, customer insight and close collaboration with sales.

Working with sales, subject-matter experts and corporate communication, you will position KMD as a strategic partner and create meaningful commercial conversations.

What you will do:

• Create demand: plan and execute integrated demand-generation activities across relevant channels.

What you bring:

To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A structured, proactive approach, with the ability to prioritise and manage several initiatives while moving between planning and execution.

Experience in technology, IT, consulting, professional services or another complex solution environment.

Why join KMD?

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

This is an opportunity to shape the marketing approach for KMD’s strategic accounts and see your work connected directly with customer conversations and business priorities, while joining an ambitious marketing team that is developing how it contributes to KMD’s growth.

Interested? Let’s hear from you

Want to connect key societal agendas with customers’ strategic priorities through B2B marketing? We would love to hear from you.

Are you passionate about supporting colleagues offshore? Do you want to work in the green offshore wind industry where your skills and expertise will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then you might be the Crewing Coordinator we are looking for.

**What will you do?

**As our new Crewing Coordinator, you will be in charge of effectively allocating vessel crews and supporting various initiatives for our colleagues offshore. You will support the implementation of policies and procedures while supporting the development of systems in this realm, for both colleagues on and offshore.

**Your Main Tasks Include

**

• Coordinate the scheduling of vessel crews via electronic rotas so personnel are allocated effectively, ensuring manning requirements are met.

• Coordinate the booking of flights, rail tickets, hire cars and hotels for both vessel crew changes (and training courses where necessary).

• Assist the HR/ Head of Marine HR with the induction and initial documentation for offshore crew.

• Support the implementation of recruitment campaigns to source personnel to fill offshore crewing requirements.

• Advise and support project and department manager’s resourcing needs.

• Input data into the HR database and create reports to be analysed by the HR/ Crewing Manager.

• Maintaining all relevant databases including personnel files and offshore crew certification.

• Aiding in internal and external audits when required

• Liaising with internal and external stakeholders in defining crew change requirements and crewing levels.

**To succeed in this role

**Being part of the Cadeler community means you will have a natural interest and care for the environment and our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Your environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for someone who can stay and work calmly in a high-pressure environment. You have a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and take pride in delivering tasks efficiently and to a high standard.

We think you will be a good match if you:

• 4+ years of work experience in an office environment, preferably in the crew coordination space

• Good knowledge of the Microsoft Office Package

• Strong communication skills and proficiency in English (written and spoken)

• Organised, structured and able to handle multiple priorities

• Prior knowledge of Compas or Omega is an advantage

**Why Cadeler?

**At Cadeler, we believe in building what matters. As part of a global team working in the offshore wind industry, you will contribute to projects that support the energy transition and help shape a more sustainable future.

We believe in trust, collaboration and shared responsibility. We give our people the opportunity to take ownership, develop their skills and grow together, while maintaining high standards in everything we do.

Join us and become part of a team where your contribution matters, your ideas are valued and we set the standard together.

**Come work with us!

**By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler has a global presence, with offices in Copenhagen, Vejle, Norwich, Rotterdam, and Taipei, alongside colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIVs).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

**Apply

**Use the APPLY button to apply for this position. For data protection purposes, applications are only accepted via the link and are assessed continuously until we find the right candidate, so please don’t hesitate to send in your application as soon as possible.

Please be aware, that if hired for the position the title will be Crewing Logistics Coordinator.

If you have any questions regarding the position or practical matters, please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.

jobs.occupation: Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead, Operational Transformation, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by the opportunity to deepen your leadership, commercial and advisory impact while contributing to sustainable growth in the operational transformation area? As Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead for Valcon’s Operational Transformation team, you will play a key role in developing our people, strengthening client partnerships and evolving our capabilities. And you will be instrumental in growing the area considerably in the future matching Valcon’s growth ambitions.

Role and profile

The job is located at the intersection between client delivery, team leadership, commercial work and service offering development.

You will lead a team of approximately 12 consultants and help shape the continued development of our Operational Transformation offerings, focused on Process Redesign and Process Automation, including agentic automation. You are expected to support the further integration of AI, data and technological capabilities into the services based on a clear understanding of our clients’ business needs and strategic ambitions. The ideal candidate brings deep experience and insight from both operations’ excellence and business process redesign as well as technology-driven business change and automation.

You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to Valcon’s growth by being commercial active, building trusted client relationships and lead projects that deliver sustainable results.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these four competence areas:

• Team leadership: Guide, inspire and develop a talented team of consultants, fostering an inclusive environment where people can thrive, collaborate effectively and deliver meaningful results together

• Commercial growth: Strengthen Valcon’s position as a trusted advisor by building long-term client partnerships and creating sustainable growth opportunities together with clients

• Client engagement: Manage and deliver complex projects with high-quality standards from initial mobilization to final delivery and further expansions

• Service development leadership: Develop internal capabilities and strengthen methodologies with AI, data, and technology as key enablers of business transformation

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The ability to balance time between all four areas is key, as they are equally important for success in this role.

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• People skills: Build and nurture existing relationships and teams through empathy, engagement and effective communication with clear direction

• Business and digital acumen: Think analytically and strategically with a pragmatic approach to execution. View AI, data and digital technology as integral elements of modern business development

• Subject-matter-expertise: Business process redesign, improvement and automation

• Education: Speak and write English fluently and professionally, with Danish being a plus. Completed relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience. Further education is a plus

Organisation and reporting

You will be the direct people manager of the Operational Transformation team of consultants (excluding Associate Partners and Partners) or managing their people managers. The role reports to a Partner from either one of our Commercial Sectors or our Head of Consulting.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Århus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex transformation projects in the business and technological space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering or Telecom Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience fiber types and their application, physical fiber characteristics, and standard testing tools (e.g., Optical Spectrum Analyzer (OSA), Bit Error Rate Tester (BERT), Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR)).

• Experience in telecommunications, carrier class optical network infrastructure, transmission systems, layer2/3 routers, and data services.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience with managing or directing field operation technicians, engineers, contractors or vendors in a Telco working environment.

• Experience in developing and implementing automation solutions for network deployment or similar processes.

• Experience with process improvement or process engineering methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).

• Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, lead technical projects, prioritize and manage project timelines.

• Ability to travel up to 50% as necessary.

• Strong investigative and problem-solving skills, with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

jobs.occupation: Engineer with Administrative Background and interested in Aviation.
jobs.description:
AIR ALSIE A/S is a Danish aviation company headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark. Our core business activities include flight operations, business aviation charter services and aircraft maintenance.

AIR ALSIE A/S is Scandinavia’s largest regional airline within the business aviation segment, and we are experiencing rapid growth and continuous development. As our organisation continues to expand, we are looking to strengthen our Technical Engineering team with a dedicated and skilled professional.

The Position

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Engineer or Aircraft Technician with a strong administrative mindset and an interest in aviation regulations and compliance.

The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge of aircraft maintenance with strong administrative skills and an understanding of regulatory requirements. You will play an important role in supporting and developing our technical organisation, ensuring that documentation, procedures and processes meet applicable aviation standards and regulatory requirements.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work across technical and administrative functions, collaborate with colleagues throughout the organisation and contribute to the continued development of AIR ALSIE A/S.

Are you passionate about aviation and motivated by being part of a dedicated team working towards shared goals? Do you want to take responsibility, make a difference and contribute to the future development of AIR ALSIE A/S? Then we would like to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

• 
Manage, maintain and update technical documentation and records in accordance with applicable aviation regulations and authority requirements.

• 
Maintain and update the Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE), ensuring continued compliance with relevant regulatory requirements.

• 
Establish and maintain effective communication and cooperation with aviation authorities.

• 
Coordinate and collaborate with internal departments on matters relating to flight operations and aircraft maintenance.

• 
Support the development and implementation of improvements to aircraft maintenance processes, procedures and working methods.

• 
Assist in the planning and coordination of aircraft maintenance programmes and resource allocation.

• 
Support the development and maintenance of employee training, competency and qualification programmes.

• 
Contribute to ensuring a high standard of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency across the organisation.

Your Profile and Qualifications

We are looking for a structured and proactive individual who enjoys working with both technical matters and administrative tasks.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
An educational background in aircraft engineering, aircraft maintenance or a related technical field, combined with administrative experience.

• 
Experience with aircraft maintenance procedures, processes and practices.

• 
Knowledge of aviation regulations, compliance requirements and industry standards.

• 
Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to documentation and administrative tasks.

• 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

• 
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

• 
The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and maintain an overview in a dynamic working environment.

• 
A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to handle challenges efficiently.

• 
An aircraft maintenance licence, certification or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

At AIR ALSIE A/S, you will become part of an ambitious and growing aviation company where your contribution matters.

We offer:

• 
An exciting position in a dynamic and developing aviation industry.

• 
A varied role with a combination of technical, administrative and regulatory responsibilities.

• 
Opportunities for professional development, further training and relevant certifications.

• 
A collaborative and supportive working environment with highly skilled and dedicated colleagues.

• 
The opportunity to influence processes and contribute to the continued development of our technical organisation.

• 
Competitive salary and employment conditions in accordance with your qualifications.

A Great Place to Work

At AIR ALSIE A/S, we believe that our employees are our greatest asset. We offer an informal working environment characterised by mutual respect, strong teamwork and a high level of professional expertise.

We strive to create an inspiring workplace where employees are encouraged to take responsibility, share their knowledge and continuously develop their skills and talents.

Our continued growth and success are driven by the commitment, expertise and dedication of our employees. We believe in working together, supporting one another and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to make a difference.

Would you like to be part of our journey?

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to the AIR ALSIE team!

Visit our website www.alsie.com to read more about our company.

Questions

If any questions, feel free to contact Maintenance Manager Torsten Plank Lorentzen TPL@alsie.com or by phone +45 74429888.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

If you recognise yourself in the profile described above and are motivated to take on the role of Engineer or Aircraft Technician at AIR ALSIE A/S, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Please submit your motivated application, CV and relevant educational certificates through our website at www.alsie.com.

Application deadline: 1 December 2026

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be conducted throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

Please use the reference “Engineer or Aircraft Technician – 2026” when submitting your application.

We are looking for someone who can join our team as soon as possible, or by mutual agreement.

Interviews will take place at our offices in Sønderborg, Denmark.

We look forward to receiving your application and hopefully welcoming you to the AIR ALSIE team!

Student worker – AI & Finance

Are you passionate about making a difference in the world through innovative BioSolutions?

ALGIECEL is a BioSolutions company on a mission to deliver sustainable, high-quality ingredients at scale – meeting the growing global demand without pressuring our planet’s ecosystem. Harnessing nature’s own way and putting it to use at industrial scale, we grow microalgae using light and CO2 in modular photobioreactors.

With the way we feed the world today, we are overexploiting planetary boundaries. There is a critical need for reliable partners who can translate innovation into industrial capacity for sustainable ingredients at scale. ALGIECEL provides an alternative with low CO2, water and land use, for customers that want to decarbonize their value chain.

You will play an important role in helping us drive the daily challenges of a start-up, with hands-on learning experience in AI, operations, finance & fundraising, as well as project management and engagement with the company’s leadership team and relevant external stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who can catch a lot of tasks and execute with quality those that matter. This role is perfect for a motivated student eager to step into a dynamic and fast paced work environment with high diversity of learning- and career development opportunities.

WHO ARE YOU?

• You are a 1st year master student based in Copenhagen, with studies in business, finance or Data/AI/Automation

• You are top of your class and consider yourself a high achiever among your peers.

• You have excellent written and verbal English skills (Danish is not a requirement)

• You have relevant work experience, as well as international experience.

WHAT WILL YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES BE AT ALGIECEL?

• You will drive the standardization and automation of existing operational workstreams in the company, while developing the company's AI toolbox.

• You will apply the above as well to support internal financial reporting to management and other relevant stakeholders.

• You will support and drive efforts to increase adoption of AI tools across the diverse team, as well as explore and execute use cases in parallel.

• You will participate in efforts related to fundraising for public grants, as well as equity rounds.

• Further, there will be ad hoc tasks and project, generally in support and collaboration of the company's Chief of Staff as your direct manager, as well as to the CEO and CFO.

HOW WILL YOU EXCEL IN YOUR ROLE?

• You try to add value to projects, in excess of what your instructions were.

• You are proactive, find things that need fixing and speak your mind, while also enjoying feedback and coaching from your team members.

• You enjoy optimizing workstreams and developing innovative solutions for getting to a stronger output with the same resources

• You consider yourself skilled at working with excel, as well as well-known, open-source LLMs and agent platforms.

• You have a continuously growing portfolio of tools, which you purposefully add to, such as for automation, modelling and related tasks, formerly executed manually in excel.

• You know you are, for now, a junior part of a larger team, but you want to become more impactful by taking on more responsibility and growing with the company (also full-time).

• You know your strengths, as well as your development areas and enjoy working on both with purpose.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• An in-office student job with 15-20 hours weekly, located at the Danish Technological Institute near Taastrup.

• A competitive salary as well as IT equipment and subscriptions provided to get your job done.

• A hands-on learning platform, working together with former senior executives and leadership from companies such as Novonesis, Ørsted, Topsoe, Saxo Bank, Cargill and AB Agri.

• Being part of an ambitious and diverse team, on track of an ambitious scaling journey in a competitive industry

For questions to the company, position and hiring process, you can contact Head of Finance/Chief of Staff Jascha Jäger under career@algiecel.com.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important to us

**Group IT keeps SimCorp running. The same discipline we bring to our clients' investment operations is applied to our own enterprise platforms. Workday and Salesforce are at the center of how we manage our people and client relationships.

As Senior Director, Enterprise Applications, you will own the strategy, governance, and operational health of Workday and Salesforce across the organization. You will serve as the primary accountable leader for these platforms, partnering closely with business functions to ensure secure, compliant, and reliable operations through your leadership team and subject matter experts.

This is a senior leadership position with high visibility across Group IT, P&C, and Sales, providing direct influence over the evolution of two of SimCorp's most business-critical enterprise platforms.

You will step directly into a strategic and business-critical transformation initiative: the migration of financial processes and data from Workday to SAP S/4HANA, with a planned go-live in January 2027. Success in this role requires the ability to quickly engage in data mapping, integration planning, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution from day one.

**The organization consists of:

**

• 5 individual contributors reporting directly to the role

• 2 managers reporting directly to the role

• 29 employees in total across the Enterprise Applications area

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Define and own the multi-year strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Workday and Salesforce, aligning platform capabilities and investments with business priorities and growth objectives

• Establish and chair platform governance forums with P&C, Sales, Customer Success, and other key stakeholders to prioritize enhancements, integrations, releases, and investment decisions

• Ensure the stability, performance, security, and availability of Workday and Salesforce through effective release management, testing, monitoring, and change control practices

• Oversee the end-to-end integration landscape across Workday, Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA

• Manage strategic relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers, including contracts, licensing, and commercial oversight in partnership with Software Asset Management

• Own platform security and access governance, including role design, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews, and compliance with internal control requirements

• Partner closely with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, and Internal Audit teams to ensure effective controls, timely remediation activities, and adherence to GDPR and other regulatory requirements

• Drive continuous improvement and adoption of platform capabilities to increase business value, operational efficiency, and user experience across the organization

**What We Value

**

• 10+ years of leadership experience in enterprise applications, with deep expertise in Workday and Salesforce, or solid hands-on experience in one platform combined with demonstrated leadership responsibility for the other

• 5+ years of people management experience leading teams of platform owners, administrators, business analysts, or related application specialists

• A proven track record of establishing and operating governance models for enterprise platforms in a global, regulated, or financial services environment

• Solid understanding of enterprise integration architectures.

• Experience managing SaaS vendors, software licensing, commercial agreements, and strategic partner relationships

• Solid knowledge of data privacy, risk, and security frameworks, including GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001

• Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at both executive and technical levels

• Workday and/or Salesforce certifications are considered an advantage

**Benefits

**Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we provide custom paths for professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**For Poland Location

**Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement.

Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp: www.simcorp.com/career

**Next steps

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

**Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

**At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.
